extraction.source_purpose: A compact identity kit for Umer Sajid’s entry-level machine-learning portfolio specifying visual choices, copy treatment, usage rules, and evidence-handling guidance.
verified_facts: Identity decision: 'Quiet technical clarity.' The portfolio should make the work easy to inspect, not compete with it: concise claims, visible methods, public evidence, and one clear next action.
This kit is for Umer Sajid’s entry-level machine-learning portfolio and supports the leakage-aware content-prioritisation case study.
The case study reports an improvement in Precision@50 from 0.340 for the baseline to 0.540 for the model on seven held-out clients.
Display + body font: Manrope (Google Fonts). Use: Headings, navigation, body copy, captions, and data labels.
Main colour: #0F766E — deep teal (for links, primary buttons, active navigation, small visual anchors).
Text colour: #172033 — near-black navy (primary reading text and chart labels).
Accent colour: #F9735B — coral (used for one data-point accent, status emphasis, or an important result only; never used for body text).
Mark: Teal U monogram with a coral data-point accent (for favicon, profile/avatar fallback, and compact navigation mark).
Name treatment: 'UMER SAJID' appears in Manrope ExtraBold or Bold, all caps only in compact navigation. On the hero and case-study pages, use title case: 'Umer Sajid'.
Role line text: 'Machine Learning Intern — evidence-first content intelligence projects.' (set in regular weight).

Two-line style note for the Claude Project is: 'Use a quiet technical portfolio style: Manrope typography, deep teal #0F766E, near-black #172033, warm off-white #FAFAF8, and coral #F9735B only as a focused result accent. Prefer concise evidence-first copy, generous whitespace, real project captures, accessible contrast, and a single clear action that leads to the case study.'

Usage rules (Do): Lead with the case-study result, then explain the method and limitation; Use teal for actions and coral for a single important number or dot; Use the U monogram only at small scale and preserve its empty margin; Keep content readable before adding motion or visual effects.

Usage rules (Avoid): Decorative gradients, stock AI imagery, or a colour palette that overwhelms evidence; Coral body text, multiple accent colours, or competing calls to action; Replacing real work captures with generated illustrations; Claiming production impact beyond the public capstone evidence.
The identity choices, mark, and style note are stated as complete and versioned here.

The Claude Project style note must be pasted into Umer’s personal Claude Project by Umer because it requires access to his authenticated account; this is recorded as a personal-account action rather than marked complete.
Reference provided for the capstone report: https://github.com/UmerSajid842/flyrankmlproject/blob/main/work/capstone_report.md
limits_or_unknowns: The document does not include implementation code (CSS, HTML) for the typography, colours, or mark.
The actual monogram image file is referenced by path but not embedded in this text; availability of that asset is not demonstrated here.
No responsive sizing, spacing scale, or exact font-size/line-height values are specified.
No accessibility testing results or contrast pass/fail metrics are provided.
The document states the Claude Project paste is a required personal action but does not show that action has been performed.

(4) Confirm the Claude Project style-note has been pasted into Umer’s personal Claude Project account (this is a personal-account action and is not shown here).
